questions: Have you ever had a seizure where your whole body shakes and you lose consciousness?
Do you ever have jerking in other parts of your body that is not triggered by seeing something?
Have you noticed any problems with your balance or coordination?
Have you noticed any changes in your thinking or memory recently?
Has this jerking been getting worse over time?
Is there anyone in your family with epilepsy or similar jerking problems?
Have you started any new medications in the last few months?
Do you have any known problems with your liver or kidneys?
Are you currently using any illegal drugs?
